field_principles.archived_task_ids: Lists exactly the fourteen V516 task ids carried forward.
field_principles.artifact_selection_policy: Must equal exact_declared_deliverable to forbid glob or mtime selection.
field_principles.blocked_gate_task_ids: Records gate-blocked V516 tasks without calling them nulls.
field_principles.blocked_precondition_task_ids: Reserved for primary blocked-precondition classes; Exp5791 is primary failed-delivery here.
field_principles.canonical_artifact_hashes: Hashes existing declared artifacts and records missing declared paths.
field_principles.canonical_identity_contract: Defines canonical evidence as milestone, task id, and declared deliverable.
field_principles.collision_scan: Shows the Exp5796-Exp5808 namespace scan and allowed plan references.
field_principles.conductor_outcomes: Preserves conductor execution authority, including delivery failures and gate skips.
field_principles.conductor_unchanged: Bare boolean must remain true by operator instruction.
field_principles.declared_deliverable_matrix: Lists every V516 task with its exact declared deliverable.
field_principles.docs_reconciled: Records transition-owned reconciliation mode without touching ops docs.
field_principles.duplicate_history_diagnostics: Reports duplicate history without deleting, sorting, or rewriting it.
field_principles.experiment: Names the local experiment slug without relying on paths.
field_principles.experiment_id: Binds this receipt to the conductor task id.
field_principles.failed_delivery_task_ids: Records bootstrap-ordered output delivery failures from conductor evidence.
field_principles.field_principles: Maps every top-level artifact field to its evidence boundary.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal summary starts with complete: or blocked: and does not promote gate blocks.
field_principles.inference_substrate: This transition uses exact local artifacts and conductor rows only; no LLM is involved.
field_principles.milestone_from: Names the terminal milestone whose conductor evidence is archived.
field_principles.milestone_to: Names the milestone receiving the archived evidence.
field_principles.missing_task_ids: Records declared V516 deliverables that are intentionally absent.
field_principles.negative_result_task_ids: Records complete negative stream-readiness evidence without hiding execution.
field_principles.next_range_collision_count: Bare scalar namespace safety gate for downstream allocation.
field_principles.next_task_range: Records the destination task interval as exp5796-exp5808.
field_principles.no_solve_task_ids: Records ARC work with no solve credit.
field_principles.operational_task_ids: Records completed transition or capstone operations outside science outcome classes.
field_principles.positive_result_task_ids: Records V516 tasks with positive terminal evidence.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records exact inputs and resource checks before mutation or claims.
field_principles.random_seed: Deterministic metadata for checksum stability; no stochastic run occurs.
field_principles.research_complete_append_count: Records the exactly-once archive receipt; zero when V516 is already present.
field_principles.research_roadmap_unchanged: Bare boolean must remain true because active roadmap mutation is forbidden.
field_principles.retired_task_ids: Carries retired prior scopes from the V516 capstone without making them V516 results.
field_principles.run_date: Records the operator-specified transition date as a fixed value.
field_principles.same_number_alias_groups: Shows numeric-prefix candidates as aliases that never become canonical.
field_principles.schema: Identifies the versioned Exp5796 transition artifact schema.
field_principles.scientific_null_task_ids: Records complete no-delta evidence without treating it as a failure.
field_principles.spec_refs: Anchors the artifact to REQ-REPORT-5796 and its scenarios.
field_principles.status: Bare terminal transition state derived from explicit precondition checks.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: Observed verification exits are recorded without relabeling failures.
